about: The writer renamed Ideas/idea-mara.md to Ideas/idea-mara-keeper.md. The renamed note holds no tagged copies (an earlier run's copy was untagged, or the writer untagged it), so no handled entry names the old path. The Brain Dump count line's entry has pointer [Ideas/idea-mara.md], a story note that no longer exists, and the line's pointer now names Ideas/idea-mara-keeper.md, which does. The line matches its entry with link targets left out, so it is not new work, and the change in its pointer gives the rename. The only new work is the supply boat line. batches.json `renamed` holds the rename.
